Taixing Bi is an AI Infrastructure Engineer with 7+ years of experience building production LLM systems, including RAG pipelines, multi-agent orchestration (LangGraph), and LLM evaluation/observability (LangSmith). Taixing has deployed low-latency inference services and built scalable data/streaming platforms using AWS and Kafka.

Taixing Bi has a publication titled 'A Novel Approach to Impedance-based Fault Location for High Voltage Cables', published at IEEE IAS in 2012.
